name: Context.dev

business_model.summary: Context.dev provides a web scraping and brand data API that delivers structured data, markdown, and brand intelligence to developers and AI agents on a subscription or usage-based credit model.

evidence.quote: Context.dev offers Developer ($25/mo), Pro ($149/mo), and Scale ($499/mo), plus Enterprise for teams that need more than 2M credits a month

team.summary: The company is led by solo founder Yahia, a former Amazon and Sunrun engineer who previously co-founded two acquired startups, StockAlarm.io and essense.io.

evidence.quote: Hi Hacker News, I’m Yahia.
Before, I worked at Amazon and Sunrun, and co-founded StockAlarm.io & essense.io, both of which were acquired.
re-applied at which point I got in as a solo founder.

product.summary: Context.dev is an API that scrapes websites, crawls sitemaps, extracts structured data via JSON Schema, and retrieves brand assets like logos, colors, and fonts.

evidence.quote: You can send us a URL and get back clean Markdown, rendered HTML, screenshots, extracted images, etc..
For more custom use cases, you can send a URL plus a JSON Schema and ask us to extract structured data

size_hint.summary: The market is driven by the transition of the web to become legible to AI agents, requiring clean, real-time context rather than frozen training data.

evidence.quote: Agents need clean/current context from the web, and this is the best way I’ve found to give it to them.
evidence.author: modo_

evidence.quote: The internet is clearly moving in this direction: companies are starting to realize their sites need to be legible to agents.
evidence.author: modo_

competitors.summary: The web scraping and retrieval space is highly crowded, featuring well-funded players, other YC startups, and self-hosted alternatives.

evidence.quote: Even within YC, there are many competitors that do pretty much the same thing: - Firecrawl - BrowserUse - Browserbase - CloudCruise
evidence.author: jackienotchan

evidence.quote: And then you have the extremely well-funded web retrieval players like Parallel and Exa.
evidence.author: jackienotchan

evidence.quote: how's this different from offerings from cloudflare, firecrawl, tavily, exa?
evidence.author: htrp

why_now.summary: AI agents and LLMs require real-time web context to avoid knowledge cutoff limitations, but building and maintaining custom scraping infrastructure internally is highly inefficient.

evidence.quote: Feeding agents knowledge frozen at the model's cutoff
Building crawlers, scrapers, and pipelines internally

risks.risk: Intense competition and commoditization in the web scraping and retrieval market, making differentiation difficult.

evidence.quote: How did you find your differentiation in a highly commoditized space? It's probably one of the most crowded spaces.
evidence.author: jackienotchan

risks.risk: Backlash and blocking from website owners due to the negative side effects of AI crawlers, such as costs and downtime.

evidence.quote: AI crawlers come with negative side effects for website owners (costs, downtime, etc.), as repeatedly reported here on HN
evidence.author: jackienotchan

risks.risk: Simple client-side workarounds using open-source libraries can replicate a significant portion of the product's core scraping value.

evidence.quote: If you want to vibe something that gets you 70% of the way to this well funded startup in like 15 minutes
evidence.author: SOLAR_FIELDS

founder_depth.why: Yahia is a solo founder with a strong technical background at Amazon and Sunrun, and a proven track record of building and successfully exiting two startups (StockAlarm.io and essense.io).

evidence.quote: Before, I worked at Amazon and Sunrun, and co-founded StockAlarm.io & essense.io, both of which were acquired.

shipping_evidence.why: The product is fully live with comprehensive documentation, multiple official SDKs, and active paying users who have integrated the API into production.

evidence.quote: Since it’s an API, here are the docs: https://docs.context.dev/quickstart .
We provide official SDKs for TypeScript, Python, Ruby, Go, and PHP.
Had it in production within an hour of signing up
evidence.author: modo_

demand_signal.why: Strong demand signal with multiple named, high-profile startup customers (Mintlify, SiteGPT, daily.dev, DocsBot, Tinfoil) actively using the product and migrating from competitors.

evidence.quote: SiteGPT, the AI chatbot platform for customer support, switched from Firecrawl to Context.dev
We used Zyte before, but switched to Context.dev due to the ZDR offering

defensibility.why: While the workflow integrations (JSON schema extraction, brand profiles) add value, the core technology relies on web scraping, which is highly commoditized and faces numerous direct competitors.

evidence.quote: How did you find your differentiation in a highly commoditized space? It's probably one of the most crowded spaces.
evidence.author: jackienotchan

analysis.case_summary: The strongest point is the founder's proven track record of shipping and exits combined with immediate, high-quality customer adoption from named startups; the weakest point is the intense competition and low technical defensibility in a highly commoditized web scraping market.
would_change_my_mind: If major competitors like Firecrawl or Exa aggressively cut prices, rendering Context.dev's pricing uncompetitive.
If website anti-bot protections (like Cloudflare Turnstile) become so advanced that Context.dev's bypass rates drop significantly, causing high failure rates.
If legal or regulatory crackdowns on AI web scraping make it impossible to scrape public websites without explicit opt-in.
data_gaps: No GitHub repository stats or public code repository links were provided to evaluate the open-source traction or code quality.
No exact revenue figures, MRR, or growth rates are disclosed in the sources.
No details on the exact infrastructure or proxy network used to bypass advanced bot protections (e.g., whether they use residential proxies).
